description.value: Banchan Su is a Korean food shop in New Westminster specializing in authentic banchan (Korean side dishes), soups, stews, braised meats, and kimchi available for individual takeout via online order. The business also offers event catering and meal box delivery with rotating weekly set menus featuring traditional Korean home-style cooking. A touring cyclist passing through New Westminster can order ready-to-eat items ranging from kimchi and braised tofu to LA-style short ribs and japchae for a hearty, flavourful stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at banchansu.net is active and confirmed, providing the full address '1122 5th Avenue, New Westminster, BC V3M 1Y6', two phone numbers, and an email — the OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but New Westminster is a distinct municipality, so the address has been corrected to match the website. The business operates primarily as a takeout and online-order Korean banchan shop with catering and meal box services; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. Takeout is confirmed as the core business model via the full online ordering system visible across multiple subpages.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the website explicitly states the address is in New Westminster, BC (postal code V3M 1Y6), a separate municipality — address corrected to website value.
OSM has no phone number listed; phone was sourced from the website footer ((778) 242-1050).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Korean food business with a functioning website, confirmed physical address, and online ordering. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking authentic Korean takeout in New Westminster.

Packed lunches.detail: Dedicated MealBox (도시락) section on website offers packaged bento-style meal boxes with rice, soup, kimchi, salad, and side dishes; minimum order 20 units, also available for events
